## Trip Distribution

The model used the 2012 Household Travel Survey to calibrate trip lengths for internal and external person trips. Trips were calibrated based on generalized cost trip length frequencies and validated to time and distance trip length frequencies and average trip lengths. The validation results are shown in @fig-ave-trip-length and @fig-trip-length-freq. Trip lengths by time and distance met the validation targets and aligned closely with target data.

No target data was available for internal and external commercial vehicle calibration. CV trips were calibrated based on previous model estimation and validated relative to person work and other trip lengths.

```{python}
# See report/preprocess/distribution.py.
df_flat = vs.load_cached_per_run(repo_root, "mod_trips_dist_gc")
```

```{python}
# 1. CALCULATE EXACT AVERAGES (grouped by calib_run too -- df_flat holds
#    every calibration run's modeled data; Target is recomputed per run's
#    subset, which is redundant but not wrong, since Trips_Tgt is identical
#    across runs)
avg_records = []
for var_col, var_name in [('Dist', 'Dist'), ('GC', 'GC')]:
    for source_col, source_name in [('Trips_Mod', 'Model'), ('Trips_Tgt', 'Target')]:

        # Calculate weighted average: sum(Trips * Value) / sum(Trips)
        grouped = df_flat.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run']).apply(
            lambda x: (x[source_col] * x[var_col]).sum() / x[source_col].sum() if x[source_col].sum() > 0 else np.nan
        ).reset_index(name='AVG_TRIP_LEN')

        grouped['DataSource'] = source_name
        grouped['Variable'] = var_name
        avg_records.append(grouped)

gcdtime_Stats = pd.concat(avg_records, ignore_index=True)

# 2. CALCULATE TRIP LENGTH FREQUENCIES (TLF)
df_flat['Dist_BIN'] = np.floor(df_flat['Dist']).astype(int)
df_flat['GC_BIN'] = np.floor(df_flat['GC']).astype(int)

tlf_records = []
for var_col, var_name in [('Dist_BIN', 'Dist'), ('GC_BIN', 'GC')]:
    for source_col, source_name in [('Trips_Mod', 'freqMod'), ('Trips_Tgt', 'freqTgt')]:

        # Group by purpose, run, and bin, sum the trips
        binned = df_flat.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run', var_col])[source_col].sum().reset_index()
        binned.rename(columns={var_col: 'BIN', source_col: 'TRIPS'}, inplace=True)

        # Calculate percentage (frequency) within each purpose x run
        total_trips = binned.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run'])['TRIPS'].transform('sum')
        binned = binned[total_trips > 0].copy()
        if binned.empty:
            continue

        total_trips = binned.groupby(['Purpose', 'calib_run'])['TRIPS'].transform('sum')
        binned['freq'] = binned['TRIPS'] / total_trips

        binned['TLFTYPE'] = var_name
        binned['freqSource'] = source_name
        binned.rename(columns={'Purpose': 'TRIPPURP'}, inplace=True)

        tlf_records.append(binned[['TRIPPURP', 'calib_run', 'BIN', 'freq', 'TLFTYPE', 'freqSource']])

dfObsModelMerge = pd.concat(tlf_records, ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
gcdtime_Stats['Purpose'] = pd.Categorical(gcdtime_Stats['Purpose'], categories=order_mapped, ordered=True)
gcdtime_Stats['order'] = gcdtime_Stats['Purpose'].cat.codes
gcdtime_Stats = gcdtime_Stats.sort_values('Purpose')
```

```{ojs}
viewof varSelect = Inputs.select(new Map([['Generalized Cost','GC'], ['Distance', 'Dist']]), {value: 'GC', label: "Variable"})

// No Purpose Set selector -- all purposes shown in one dumbbell chart below,
// grouped into their Internal/Commercial Vehicle/External sections by the
// same order gcdtime_Stats already sorted them into (see fig-ave-trip-length).
// PurpType is null for purposes outside all three groups (e.g. HBC, present
// in the underlying matrices but not part of `order`) -- the old purpSelect
// filter silently dropped these too (they never matched any dropdown value),
// so exclude them explicitly now that nothing else does.
dataLT = transpose(dataStats)
filtered_data = dataLT.filter(function(dataL) {
    return varSelect == dataL.Variable && dataL.calib_run === globalCalibRun && dataL.PurpType != null;
})

purpTypeLabel = new Map([
  ["InternalTripPurposes", "Internal Trip Purposes"],
  ["InternalTruckPurposes", "Internal Commercial Vehicle Purposes"],
  ["Externals", "External Trip Purposes"]
])

import {Legend, Swatches} from "@d3/color-legend"
import {howto, altplot} from "@d3/example-components"
```

#### Plot

Purposes below are grouped, top to bottom, into Internal Trip Purposes, Internal
Commercial Vehicle Purposes, and External Trip Purposes (a light rule marks each
group boundary).

```{ojs}
//|label: fig-ave-trip-length
//|fig-cap: Average Trip Length
//|echo: False

// One dumbbell row per purpose (Model dot -- Target dot), instead of a
// facet-per-purpose pair of bars -- same shape as filtered_data's Purpose
// values already carry a sort-order prefix ("22-II_MD_Adj"), stripped below
// for the tick label only, ordering itself untouched.
atlPurposes = [...new Set(filtered_data.map(d => d.Purpose))]

atlRows = atlPurposes.map(p => {
  const model = filtered_data.find(d => d.Purpose === p && d.DataSource === "Model");
  const target = filtered_data.find(d => d.Purpose === p && d.DataSource === "Target");
  const any = model ?? target;
  const modelVal = model ? model.AVG_TRIP_LEN : null;
  const targetVal = target ? target.AVG_TRIP_LEN : null;
  return {
    Purpose: p,
    PurposeLabel: p.replace(/^\d+-/, ""),
    PurpType: any?.PurpType,
    Model: modelVal,
    Target: targetVal,
    pctDiff: (modelVal != null && targetVal != null && targetVal !== 0) ? (modelVal - targetVal) / targetVal : null
  };
}).filter(d => d.Model != null || d.Target != null);

atlLinkRows = atlRows.filter(d => d.Model != null && d.Target != null);

// A boundary sits just above each row that starts a new PurpType group
// (skipping the very first row, which has no boundary above it) -- atlRows
// is already contiguous by group, from gcdtime_Stats' own sort order.
atlGroupBoundaries = atlRows
  .filter((d, i) => i > 0 && d.PurpType !== atlRows[i - 1].PurpType)
  .map(d => d.Purpose)

// Headroom for the +/-% labels past the rightmost dot.
atlXMax = (d3.max(atlRows, d => Math.max(d.Model ?? 0, d.Target ?? 0)) || 1) * 1.15

// A "-X%" label to the left of a dot sitting near x=0 would spill into the
// y-axis label column (marginLeft) -- force those onto the right instead,
// same as a row where Model already reads to the right of Target.
atlNearZero = atlXMax * 0.18
atlLabelsRight = atlRows.filter(d => d.pctDiff != null && (d.Model >= d.Target || d.Model < atlNearZero))
atlLabelsLeft = atlRows.filter(d => d.pctDiff != null && d.Model < d.Target && d.Model >= atlNearZero)

Plot.plot({
  y: {domain: atlPurposes, label: null, tickFormat: p => atlRows.find(d => d.Purpose === p)?.PurposeLabel ?? p},
  x: {domain: [0, atlXMax], tickFormat: "s", grid: true, label: varSelect === "GC" ? "Generalized Cost" : "Distance"},
  color: {
    domain: ["Model", "Target"],
    range: [themeModel, themeTarget],
    legend: true
  },
  style: {fontSize: 16, fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"},
  marginTop: 10,
  marginBottom: 40,
  marginRight: 55,
  marginLeft: 125,
  height: Math.max(atlPurposes.length * 28, 80),
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY(atlGroupBoundaries, {y: p => p, dy: -14, stroke: themeNeutral, strokeOpacity: 0.4}),
    Plot.link(atlLinkRows, {x1: "Model", x2: "Target", y: "Purpose", stroke: themeLinkGrey, strokeWidth: 3}),
    // Target drawn first, Model second, so the Model dot's ring always sits
    // on top where the two overlap -- same convention as the CVM Update
    // page's Base-Model-vs-Final dumbbells.
    Plot.dot(atlRows.filter(d => d.Target != null), {
      x: "Target", y: "Purpose", fill: themeTarget, r: 7,
      title: d => `${d.PurposeLabel}\nTarget: ${d3.format(",.1f")(d.Target)}`
    }),
    Plot.dot(atlRows.filter(d => d.Model != null), {
      x: "Model", y: "Purpose", fill: themeModel, r: 5.5,
      title: d => `${d.PurposeLabel}\nModel: ${d3.format(",.1f")(d.Model)}`
    }),
    Plot.text(atlLabelsRight, {
      x: "Model", y: "Purpose", text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d.pctDiff),
      dx: 9, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
      fill: d => Math.abs(d.pctDiff) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
    }),
    Plot.text(atlLabelsLeft, {
      x: "Model", y: "Purpose", text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d.pctDiff),
      dx: -9, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
      fill: d => Math.abs(d.pctDiff) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

### Trip Length Frequency Validation

```{python}
Markdown(f"""
The following trip length frequency charts have been updated to exclude intrazonal trips. The distance charts only include data beyond {intra_dist_min}, the time charts only include data beyond {intra_time_min}, and the general cost charts only include data beyond {intra_gc_min}. Please note that these values were calculated at a mark where the majority of the trip would not be intrazonal trips. Intrazonal trips were analyzed separately.
""")
```

```{ojs}
    label: 'Distance / Cost',

  },
  y: {

    })),
    Plot.line(freqT_filtered_Tgt, Plot.groupX({y: "sum"}, {
      x: d => Math.floor(d.BIN / binSize) * binSize,
      y: 'freq',
      stroke: themeTarget,
      strokeWidth: 3
    })),
    Plot.frame({ strokeOpacity: 0.2 })
  ]
});
```

#### Cumulative

Per-bin frequency can be jagged, especially for lower-volume purposes -- the
cumulative view below smooths past that bin-to-bin noise and makes it easy to
compare, e.g., median trip length between Model and Target directly. Computed
at the native bin resolution (not the Frequency tab's adjustable Bin Size,
which is a histogram-smoothing control a monotonic cumulative curve doesn't
need).

```{ojs}
//|label: fig-trip-length-cdf
//|fig-cap: Cumulative Trip Length Frequency
//|echo: False
//|message: False
//|error: False

function toCdf(rows) {
  const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => a.BIN - b.BIN);
  let cum = 0;
  return sorted.map(d => {
    cum += d.freq;
    return { BIN: d.BIN, cumFreq: cum };
  });
}

cdfMod = toCdf(freqT_filtered_Mod)
cdfTgt = toCdf(freqT_filtered_Tgt)

Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  height: 420,
  x: {
    label: 'Distance / Cost',
    domain: [minXValue, maxXValue]
  },
  y: {
    label: 'Cumulative Frequency',
    domain: [0, 1],
    tickFormat: f => `${Math.round(f * 100)}%`
  },
  marginRight: 40,
  marginLeft: 60,
  marginTop: 40,
  marginBottom: 50,
  style: { fontSize: 15, fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif" },
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0.5], { stroke: themeNeutral, strokeOpacity: 0.4, strokeDasharray: "4,4" }),
    Plot.line(cdfMod, { x: "BIN", y: "cumFreq", stroke: themeModel, strokeWidth: 3 }),
    Plot.line(cdfTgt, { x: "BIN", y: "cumFreq", stroke: themeTarget, strokeWidth: 3 }),
    Plot.frame({ strokeOpacity: 0.2 })
  ]
});
```

### Intrazonal Trip Percentage

```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Calcualte Observed Intrazonal Trip Percentages   #
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# read in hts trip table, filter to WF model area, calculate purpose
hts_trips = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips_path"], low_memory=False)
hts_trips = hts_trips[(hts_trips['pSUBAREAID']==1) & (hts_trips['aSUBAREAID']==1)]
hts_trips['PURP'] = np.where(
    hts_trips['PURP7_t'] == 'HBSch',
    np.where(
        hts_trips['HBSch_lev'] == 'primary',
        'HBSch_Pr',
        np.where(
            hts_trips['HBSch_lev'] == 'secondary',
            'HBSch_Sc',
            pd.NA
        )
    ),
    hts_trips['PURP7_t']
)

# filter out na and select columns
hts_trips = hts_trips[~hts_trips['PURP'].isna()]
hts_trips = hts_trips[hts_trips['trip_weight'] > 0]
hts_trips = hts_trips[['linked_trip_id','PURP','pCO_TAZID_USTMv4','aCO_TAZID_USTMv4','trip_weight']]

# flag intrazonal trips
hts_trips['is_intra'] = (hts_trips['pCO_TAZID_USTMv4'] == hts_trips['aCO_TAZID_USTMv4'])

# weighted totals by purpose
obs_intra = (
    hts_trips
        .assign(
            intra_wt = lambda x: np.where(x['is_intra'], x['trip_weight'], 0)
        )
        .groupby('PURP', as_index=False)
        .agg(
            total_trips_wt=('trip_weight', 'sum'),
            intra_trips_wt=('intra_wt', 'sum')
        )
)

# percent intrazonal
obs_intra['pct_intrazonal'] = (100 * obs_intra['intra_trips_wt'] / obs_intra['total_trips_wt'])
obs_intra = obs_intra[['PURP','pct_intrazonal']]
```

```{python}
# Convert to categorical for sorting in order

    ordered=True

df_intra['order'] = df_intra['PURP'].cat.codes

# Sort by order
```

#### Plot
```{ojs}
//|label: fig-intrazonal
//|fig-cap: Intrazonal trip percentage between model and target.
//|echo: False

intraPurposes = [...new Set(dataIntraT.map(d => d.PURP))]

intraRows = intraPurposes.map(p => {
  const model = dataIntraT.find(d => d.PURP === p && d.DataSource === "Model");
  const target = dataIntraT.find(d => d.PURP === p && d.DataSource === "Target");
  const modelVal = model ? model.pct_intrazonal : null;
  const targetVal = target ? target.pct_intrazonal : null;
  return {
    PURP: p,
    PurposeLabel: p.replace(/^\d+-/, ""),
    Model: modelVal,
    Target: targetVal,
    pctDiff: (modelVal != null && targetVal != null && targetVal !== 0) ? (modelVal - targetVal) / targetVal : null
  };
}).filter(d => d.Model != null || d.Target != null);

intraLinkRows = intraRows.filter(d => d.Model != null && d.Target != null);

// Headroom for the +/-% labels past the rightmost dot.
intraXMax = (d3.max(intraRows, d => Math.max(d.Model ?? 0, d.Target ?? 0)) || 1) * 1.15

// A "-X%" label to the left of a dot sitting near x=0 would spill into the
// y-axis label column (marginLeft) -- force those onto the right instead,
// same as a row where Model already reads to the right of Target.
intraNearZero = intraXMax * 0.18
intraLabelsRight = intraRows.filter(d => d.pctDiff != null && (d.Model >= d.Target || d.Model < intraNearZero))
intraLabelsLeft = intraRows.filter(d => d.pctDiff != null && d.Model < d.Target && d.Model >= intraNearZero)

Plot.plot({
  y: {domain: intraPurposes, label: null, tickFormat: p => intraRows.find(d => d.PURP === p)?.PurposeLabel ?? p},
  x: {domain: [0, intraXMax], tickFormat: "s", grid: true, label: "% Intrazonal"},
  color: {
    domain: ["Model", "Target"],
    range: [themeModel, themeTarget],
    legend: true
  },
  style: {fontSize: 16, fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"},
  marginTop: 10,
  marginBottom: 40,
  marginRight: 55,
  marginLeft: 115,
  height: Math.max(intraPurposes.length * 28, 80),
  marks: [
    Plot.link(intraLinkRows, {x1: "Model", x2: "Target", y: "PURP", stroke: themeLinkGrey, strokeWidth: 3}),
    // Target drawn first, Model second, so the Model dot's ring always sits
    // on top where the two overlap -- same convention as the CVM Update
    // page's Base-Model-vs-Final dumbbells.
    Plot.dot(intraRows.filter(d => d.Target != null), {
      x: "Target", y: "PURP", fill: themeTarget, r: 7,
      title: d => `${d.PurposeLabel}\nTarget: ${d3.format(",.1f")(d.Target)}%`
    }),
    Plot.dot(intraRows.filter(d => d.Model != null), {
      x: "Model", y: "PURP", fill: themeModel, r: 5.5,
      title: d => `${d.PurposeLabel}\nModel: ${d3.format(",.1f")(d.Model)}%`
    }),
    Plot.text(intraLabelsRight, {
      x: "Model", y: "PURP", text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d.pctDiff),
      dx: 9, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
      fill: d => Math.abs(d.pctDiff) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
    }),
    Plot.text(intraLabelsLeft, {
      x: "Model", y: "PURP", text: d => d3.format("+.1%")(d.pctDiff),
      dx: -9, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600,
      fill: d => Math.abs(d.pctDiff) > 0.1 ? themeDanger : themeNeutral
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Preprocess Observed HTS Trips
# ------------------------------------------------ #
obs_trips = hts_trips.copy()

# merge to get large districts and summarize accordingly
obs_trips = obs_trips.merge(tazv10[['CO_TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='pCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
obs_trips = obs_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'p_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})
obs_trips = obs_trips.merge(tazv10[['CO_TAZID','DISTLRG','CO_FIPS']], how = 'left', left_on='aCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
obs_trips = obs_trips.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg', 'CO_FIPS':'a_CO_FIPS'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})

# See report/preprocess/distribution.py.
mod_trips_all = vs.load_cached_per_run(repo_root, "master_trips")

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# Summarize Observed (shared, not run-specific)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
obs_trips_dist = obs_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
obs_trips_co = obs_trips.groupby(['PURP','p_CO_FIPS','a_CO_FIPS'], as_index=False).agg(trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
obs_trips_dist['Geo'] = 'District'
obs_trips_co['Geo'] = 'County'
obs_trips_dist = obs_trips_dist.rename(columns={'p_DistLrg': 'p_Loc', 'a_DistLrg': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'obs'})
obs_trips_co = obs_trips_co.rename(columns={'p_CO_FIPS': 'p_Loc', 'a_CO_FIPS': 'a_Loc', 'trips': 'obs'})
obs_trips_all = pd.concat([obs_trips_dist, obs_trips_co], ignore_index=True)

# Merge Model (per run) and Observed (shared) -- calib_run isn't a merge
# key, so it rides along on the modeled side, same pattern as elsewhere
master_trips = mod_trips_all.merge(
    obs_trips_all, on=['PURP', 'p_Loc', 'a_Loc', 'Geo'], how='outer'
).fillna({'mod': 0, 'obs': 0})

# filter out HBC
master_trips = master_trips[~(master_trips['PURP']=='HBC')]

# ------------------------------------------------ #
# ADD "AllPurps" CATEGORY (per calib_run)
# ------------------------------------------------ #
all_purps = master_trips.groupby(['p_Loc', 'a_Loc', 'Geo', 'calib_run'], as_index=False).agg({'mod': 'sum','obs': 'sum'})
all_purps['PURP'] = 'AllPurps'
master_trips2 = pd.concat([master_trips, all_purps], ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
# The outer merge above only fillna()s mod/obs -- an observed key with no
# matching modeled row (in any run) still gets calib_run = NaN, which
# serializes as the bare JSON token `NaN` and breaks ojs_define's
# JSON.parse() client-side (see report/1-tripgen.qmd's tripRates fix for
# the full explanation). Swap NaN for None so it serializes as valid `null`.
ojs_define(trips_master_data = master_trips2.astype(object).where(master_trips2.notna(), None))
```


```{ojs}
// 1. Data Processing
dc_final = {
  const data = transpose(trips_master_data).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  return data.map(d => ({
    ...d,
    tmeMod: d.mod,
    tmeObs: d.obs,
    tmeErrorPct: d.obs > 0 ? (d.mod - d.obs) / d.obs : 0
  })).filter(d => d.tmeObs > 0 || d.tmeMod > 0);
}

// 2. Selectors
viewof vGeo_final = Inputs.select(["District", "County"], {label: "Geography Level:", value: "District"})

// This dropdown updates its options based on what's available in the data
viewof vPurp_final = Inputs.select(
  Array.from(new Set(dc_final.map(d => d.PURP))).sort(),
  {label: "Trip Purpose:"}
)

// 3. Final Filtered Data
dc_filtered_final = dc_final.filter(d => d.Geo === vGeo_final && d.PURP === vPurp_final)

chartMax_final = d3.max(dc_filtered_final, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod)) * 1.05
```

```{python}
#=============================================================================#
# Production & Attractions by Vehicle Ownership & Income Category            #

df_trip = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_trips_path"], low_memory=False)
df_hh = pd.read_csv(config_paths["hts_hh"], low_memory=False)

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Process Observed Data (HTS)                                        #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# calculate vehicle category - income category variables
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge = df_hh.copy()
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['inc'] = np.select(
    [hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['income_detailed'].between(1, 4),hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['income_detailed'].between(5, 10)],
    ['lo', 'hi'],
    default=pd.NA
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh'] = np.select(
    [hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'] == 0,hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'] == 1,hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['num_vehicles'].between(2, 7)],
    ['0', '1', '2'],
    default=pd.NA
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh_inc'] = (
    'HBW_' + hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['veh'] + 'veh_' + hts_hh_23_hbw_merge['inc']
)
hts_hh_23_hbw_merge = hts_hh_23_hbw_merge[['hh_id','veh_inc']]

#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Summarize Observed Data (HTS)                                      #
#--------------------------------------------------------------------#
# observed data continued
hts_trip_hbw_0 = df_trip.copy()
hts_trip_hbw_0 = hts_trip_hbw_0.merge(hts_hh_23_hbw_merge,how='left',on='hh_id')

# merge to get large districts
hts_trip_hbw_1 = hts_trip_hbw_0.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='pCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
hts_trip_hbw_1 = hts_trip_hbw_1.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'p_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})
hts_trip_hbw_2 = hts_trip_hbw_1.merge(tazv10_st, how = 'left', left_on='aCO_TAZID_USTMv4', right_on='CO_TAZID')
hts_trip_hbw_2 = hts_trip_hbw_2.rename(columns={'DISTLRG':'a_DistLrg'}).drop(columns={'CO_TAZID'})

# filter and cleanup
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw_2[['unique_id','PURP7_t','veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[(hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'] > 0) & (hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'] > 0)]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[hts_trip_hbw['PURP7_t']=='HBW']
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[hts_trip_hbw['trip_weight']>0]
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[~(hts_trip_hbw['veh_inc'].isna())]
hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'] = hts_trip_hbw['p_DistLrg'].astype(int)
hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'] = hts_trip_hbw['a_DistLrg'].astype(int)
hts_trip_hbw = hts_trip_hbw[['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]

# summarize
obs_dist_hbw_sum = (
    hts_trip_hbw
        [['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg','trip_weight']]
        .groupby(['veh_inc','p_DistLrg','a_DistLrg'], as_index=False)
        .agg(total_trips=('trip_weight','sum'))
)

# See report/preprocess/distribution.py.

hbw_outliers["veh_inc"] = "HBW_" + hbw_outliers["segment"]
```

### Production & Attractions by Model

```{python}
# export to ojs dataframes
ojs_define(dist_sum_mod = dist_sum_mod_chart)
ojs_define(dist_sum_obs = dist_sum_obs_chart)
```

```{ojs}
// 1. DATA PROCESSING & INPUTS
dc = {
  const modT = transpose(dist_sum_mod).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT = transpose(dist_sum_obs);

  return modT.map(m => {
    const o = obsT.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.Source === m.Source
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      // Added Percent Error calculation for the second chart
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

// Source Selection
viewof vSource = Inputs.select(
  Array.from(new Set(dc.map(d => d.Source))).sort(),
  { label: "Model Source:" }
)

// Filtered data based on selection
dc_filtered = dc.filter(d => d.Source === vSource)

// Shared Max for the Scatter Plot axes
chartMax = d3.max(dc_filtered, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod))
```

```{python}
# Load both modeled datasets
mod_mc = mod_dist_hbw_sum.copy()
mod_db = mod_distrib_hbw_sum.copy()

# Add the Source identifier

```

```{python}
# export to ojs dataframes
ojs_define(dist_sum_mod2 = mod_combined)
ojs_define(dist_sum_obs2 = obs_dist_hbw_sum)
ojs_define(dist_sum_obs2_no_outliers = obs_dist_hbw_sum_no_outliers)
```

```{ojs}
// 1. STABLE SELECTIONS
vincs_list = Array.from(
  new Set(transpose(dist_sum_obs2).map(d => String(d.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, "")))
).sort()

// Model Type Selection
viewof vSource_2 = Inputs.select(
  ["Destination Choice", "Gravity"],
  { label: "Model Type:", value: "Destination Choice" }
)

// Observed Data Selection
viewof vRemoveOutliers_2 = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Remove outliers",
  value: true
})

// 2. DATA PROCESSING (Matches selected model source to selected observed data)
dc_2 = {
  const modT2 = transpose(dist_sum_mod2).filter(d => d.calib_run === globalCalibRun);
  const obsT2 = vRemoveOutliers_2
    ? transpose(dist_sum_obs2_no_outliers)
    : transpose(dist_sum_obs2);

  return modT2.map(m => {
    const o = obsT2.find(d =>
      d.p_DistLrg === m.p_DistLrg &&
      d.a_DistLrg === m.a_DistLrg &&
      d.veh_inc === m.veh_inc
    );

    if (!o || o.total_trips === 0) return null;

    return {
      p_DistLrg: m.p_DistLrg,
      a_DistLrg: m.a_DistLrg,
      veh_inc: m.veh_inc,
      veh_inc_clean: String(m.veh_inc).replace(/^HBW_/, ""),
      Source: m.Source,
      tmeMod: m.total_trips,
      tmeObs: o.total_trips,
      tmeErrorPct: (m.total_trips - o.total_trips) / o.total_trips
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}

// 3. FINAL FILTERING
dc_filtered_2 = dc_2.filter(d => d.Source === vSource_2)

// 4. NOTEBOOK-MATCHED METRICS
slope_through_origin = (rows) => {
  const denominator = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeObs);
  return denominator > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs * d.tmeMod) / denominator
    : 0;
}

wmape = (rows) => {
  const totalObs = d3.sum(rows, d => d.tmeObs);
  return totalObs > 0
    ? d3.sum(rows, d => Math.abs(d.tmeMod - d.tmeObs)) / totalObs
    : 0;
}

segment_summaries = vincs_list.map(seg => {
  const rows = dc_filtered_2.filter(d => d.veh_inc_clean === seg);
  return {
    seg,
    rows,
    slope: slope_through_origin(rows),
    wmape: wmape(rows),
    maxVal: d3.max(rows, d => Math.max(d.tmeObs, d.tmeMod)) || 1
  };
})

global_wmape_2 = wmape(dc_filtered_2)
avg_slope_2 = d3.mean(segment_summaries.filter(d => d.rows.length > 1), d => d.slope) || 0
obs_label_2 = vRemoveOutliers_2 ? "No Outliers" : "Standard"
```

```{ojs}
// CHART 2: Model vs Observed Trips by Segment
segment_chart = (summary) => {
  const rows = summary.rows;
  const maxVal = summary.maxVal;
  const axisMax = maxVal * 1.1;
  const fanRatios = [0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3];
  const titleText = rows.length
    ? `${summary.seg} | Slope: ${d3.format(".2f")(summary.slope)} | Error: ${d3.format(".1%")(summary.wmape)}`
    : `${summary.seg} (No Data)`;

  return html`<div class="hbw-segment-chart">
    <h4>${titleText}</h4>
    ${Plot.plot({
      grid: true,
      width: 400,
      height: 315,
      marginLeft: 50,
      marginBottom: 42,
      x: { label: "Target Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      y: { label: "Mod Trips", domain: [0, axisMax] },
      marks: [
        Plot.link(fanRatios, {
          x1: 0,
          y1: 0,
          x2: maxVal,
          y2: (r) => maxVal * r,
          stroke: "gray",
          strokeOpacity: (r) => r === 1 ? 1 : 0.25,
          strokeWidth: (r) => r === 1 ? 2 : 1,
          strokeDasharray: (r) => r === 1 ? null : "2 2"
        }),
        Plot.dot(rows, {
          x: "tmeObs",
          y: "tmeMod",
          r: 3,
          fill: themeModel,
          fillOpacity: 0.6,
          tip: true,
          title: (d) =>
            `District: ${d.p_DistLrg} to ${d.a_DistLrg}\n` +
            `Target: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeObs)}\n` +
            `Modeled: ${d3.format(",.0f")(d.tmeMod)}`
        }),
        Plot.line(
          [
            { x: 0, y: 0 },
            { x: maxVal, y: summary.slope * maxVal }
          ],
          {
            x: "x",
            y: "y",
            stroke: themeModel,
            strokeWidth: 2,
            strokeDasharray: "4 4"
          }
        )
      ]
    })}
  </div>`;
}

html`<div>
  <style>
    .hbw-segment-summary {
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0.75rem 0 1rem 0;
    }
    .hbw-segment-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(360px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .hbw-segment-chart h4 {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hbw-segment-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
  </style>
  <div class="hbw-segment-summary">
    Run: ${vSource_2} | Target: ${obs_label_2} | Global WMAPE: ${d3.format(".1%")(global_wmape_2)} | Avg Slope: ${d3.format(".2f")(avg_slope_2)}
  </div>
  <div class="hbw-segment-grid">
    ${segment_summaries.map(segment_chart)}
  </div>
</div>`
```
